Step by step

  1. A bill arrives

    Relaypoint watches Ledgerly for new bills, whether they were emailed in, uploaded or created by hand.

  2. Fields are read and checked

    Vendor, amount, PO number and due date are pulled from the bill. Duplicates of a bill paid in the last 90 days are held for review.

  3. Only the right bills need a person

    Bills over your threshold, or from new vendors, go to the controller in Murmur with the PO and bill side by side. Everything else is matched to its PO and approved.

  4. Payment is scheduled

    Approved bills are scheduled three days before they're due, so nothing is paid late and nothing is paid early.

  5. The team sees one summary

    Instead of a message per bill, #ap-daily gets one post each afternoon: what was approved, what's waiting and what needs a look.

When things don't go to plan

The exceptions are where manual processes break down. These are handled out of the box.

  • Approver is out of office

    the request moves to their named delegate automatically.

  • Bill in a foreign currency

    the threshold is checked against the converted amount on the bill date.

  • PO doesn't exist yet

    the bill waits, and the requester gets one message asking for the PO number.

  • Same invoice number from the same vendor

    held as a possible duplicate, never paid twice.
